title: {Syn} FlashAttention Made Attention More IO-Aware
content:
FlashAttention speeds up exact attention by reducing memory traffic and computing attention in tiled blocks. The math result is the same attention, but the hardware path is smarter.

It became important because transformer workloads are often bottlenecked by moving data, not just by arithmetic.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
